items.reason: The only registered intervention is a device ("Radiofrequency electromagnetic field treatment"); temozolomide is the Stupp backbone. No drug is tested, and no agent row carries an excluded type.

note: Convention question for XL: when the only tested intervention is radiotherapy or a device and the only drug is a backbone/supportive agent, S6 reason could be no_pharmacological_candidate or excluded_intervention_type (radiotherapy alone and devices are listed as excluded types in manual 1.2). Proposed no_pharmacological_candidate throughout this batch (NCT04574856, NCT06140875, NCT05284643, NCT06929819) for consistency. Registered phase NA, so excluded at S3 regardless. Both coders listed an MGMT eligibility row, but the criterion ("MGMT-promotor methylated patients must have refused therapy according to the CeTeG/NOA-09 protocol") requires no MGMT status, so any_molecular_selection is proposed false.
